supersedes: rubric.json only for future Validation pre-registration; it does not replace the recorded Development result.
scope: The v2 policy is calibrated from the committed E7/E8 Development artifact. It may be used for local regression checks only until an unseen Validation cohort and its rubric are separately frozen.
acceptanceRules: Evaluate explicitly listed facts across editable vertices and editable edge labels.
Allow only policy-listed format and bilingual equivalences.
Allow several required facts in one editable element unless a future task explicitly requires separate elements.
Do not use model-based semantic judging in the deterministic evaluator.
reviewRequirement: Two named independent reviewers must cover every frozen required claim before any Validation or holdout decision.
stoppingRule: Development v2 scores are calibration evidence only. Freeze a disjoint Validation cohort before any model run or qualification claim.
